description: This file defines a scraper class 'FlavorsByLinbie' for extracting recipe data from the website flavorsbylinbie.com, including methods for retrieving author, title, category, total time, ingredients, instructions, description, and yields.

classes.name: FlavorsByLinbie
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe information from flavorsbylinbie.com

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the target website

methods.name: author
methods.description: Extracts the author of the recipe, trying schema, HTML link, or fallback to site name

methods.name: title
methods.description: Retrieves the recipe title from title tag or H1

methods.name: category
methods.description: Gets the recipe category from schema or meta tag

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Calculates total time from headings or paragraph content

methods.name: _extract_time_from_servings_section
methods.description: Helper to extract prep or cook time from servings section

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Determines the number of servings or yield

methods.name: _get_servings_time_paragraph
methods.description: Retrieves paragraph containing servings and time info

methods.name: _slice_field
methods.description: Slices out specific field values from paragraphs

methods.name: _extract_time_from_paragraph
methods.description: Extracts minutes from paragraph based on label

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts list of ingredients from 'What You'll Need' section

methods.name: description
methods.description: Provides a brief description of the recipe
